newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 26.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:

* Walt Disney unit ABC's telecast of the 69th annual Academy Awards posted the lowest ratings in more than 10 years and the second-lowest numbers on record. Monday night's telecast also marked the second consecutive year the ratings for the Academy Awards have fallen.
* Hollywood went wild with post-Oscar mania Monday night and industry parties were jammed.
* The Motion Picture Assn. of America named Joan Graves co-chairman of its classification and rating administration.
* Disney's syndication arm Buena Vista TV has signed a deal with Keenen Ivory Wayans to produce and host a nightly, talk-variety show starting this August.
* General Electric's NBC won a close week of competition for prime time television viewers, taking total viewers for the week of March 17-23.
* Stewart Blair, the former chairman of United Artists Theater Circuit, is joining London-based Pacific Media to lead an expansion of its international film exhibition business.
